statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 16 is low and remains below the block threshold.
recommendation: The 29,660 ceiling that rejected three times has broken and the market is holding within a few points of a new session high, which is a genuine Tail amplifier and lifts the estimate from 11 to 16. It stays in the low band because volatility is decaying into the break, rates and oil are unaligned, and a clean 130-point retracement was supplied only an hour ago. The mapped policy state is EA_ON. The single mapped danger window remains 14:00-15:30 UTC on Aug 28 around the Jackson Hole keynote cluster.
headline: Fourth test of 29,660 breaks: NQ prints a new session high at 29,676 and holds it as megacap participation broadens; Tail lifts to 16
body: Nasdaq-100 futures trade at 29,671.75, up 382.25 points or 1.31% from the 29,289.50 prior settlement, roughly four hours into the U.S. cash session. The session range is 29,401.75-29,676.00 against a 29,498.25 open, which means the contract sits within five points of its high. The material change since the prior assessment is that the 29,660 area, which had rejected three separate times, gave way on the fourth attempt: the roughly 130-point retracement recorded an hour ago was fully recovered and the range has now expanded upward rather than continuing to compress. Cash confirms it. The Nasdaq-100 index reads 29,598.67, up 374.15 points or 1.28%, in a 29,366.42-29,600.47 range, so the cash high is also being set in this hour rather than defended from earlier. QQQ trades at 720.11, up 1.23%, in a 714.53-720.40 range with the low untouched since the morning. Holding near a session extreme is one of the amplifiers that Tail is designed to register, and it is the reason the estimate lifts from 11 to 16. Three independent considerations keep it inside the low band. First, volatility is decaying through the break rather than expanding: VIX trades at 14.47, down 4.86%, with a session low of 14.42 against a 15.21 prior close. An index setting highs while its volatility index sets lows is orderly price discovery, not repricing. Second, mean reversion has demonstrably been supplied today; the retracement an hour ago delivered roughly 130 points before the market went again, which is the opposite of the no-retracement path Tail measures. Third, cross-asset confirmation is absent. The 10-year constant maturity stands at 4.64% and the 2-year at 4.17% on the most recent H.15 publication, with no rates impulse behind the equity move, and WTI at $82.87, up 0.78%, continues to trade its own managed-disruption story rather than a risk impulse. Leadership has broadened during the break, and that is the one development pushing the other way. Apple now trades up 0.56% and Microsoft up 1.51%, both having been lower at the prior assessment, so megacap participation is wider than it was an hour ago. Nvidia holds a gain near 9.4% after fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $96.22 billion and third-quarter guidance near $108 billion, with Salesforce up about 21%, CrowdStrike about 19% and Okta about 28%. Index breadth beyond technology remains narrow, however: the Nasdaq Composite is up 1.51% against the S&P 500 up 0.79%, the Russell 2000 up 0.44% and the Dow up 0.36%. That split is why the dominant mode is assessed as trend-up on observed price structure while the score stays low. Macro is settled for the day. Initial jobless claims for the week to Aug 22 printed 203,000 against a 210,000 consensus, continuing claims 1,778,000, the advance goods trade deficit widened to $118.8 billion, and the Kansas City Fed composite index came in at 10; none of it moved rates or volatility. Shared cross-asset context from the repository collector was published at 13:07 UTC and is therefore outside its freshness window, so this assessment rests entirely on independently verified current sources. Mapped policy state remains EA_ON. The forward risk sits at the far edge of the horizon: Fed Chair Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole keynote on Aug 28 at 14:00 UTC, at the same instant as the preliminary payroll benchmark revision and final Michigan sentiment, with Chicago PMI fifteen minutes earlier. The keynote hour and the delayed-second-leg hour that follows are the only two slots in this forecast mapped outside the low band.

lookbackSummary: The past 24 hours cover the Nvidia release and its full digestion into a tech-led advance. From 17:00 UTC on Aug 26 the regime was mixed and calm, with Tail at 10-11 while Stress climbed from 59 to 61 as positioning built into the report. The 20:00 UTC release hour was the only non-green hour in the window, moving to WATCH at Tail 21 and Stress 66. Futures reopened at 22:00 UTC on the beat and raised outlook, and the assessment stepped down through 18 and 16 in event/whipsaw mode as the gap held without extending. Through the Asian and European hours the regime returned to mixed at Tail 10-11 with Stress easing to 45-47, the calmest stretch of the window. The 13:00 UTC hour lifted to Tail 14 and Stress 54 into the cash open, then eased back through 12, 12 and 11 across 14:00, 15:00 and 16:00 UTC as the opening auction faded and the range absorbed flow instead of extending. Three hours are unavailable because no assessment was published for them: 21:00 UTC on Aug 26 during the futures maintenance break, and 00:00 and 09:00 UTC on Aug 27. Every available hour except the release hour mapped to EA_ON.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours contain the remainder of a tech-led U.S. afternoon and one genuine catalyst cluster at the far edge. With the market holding a fresh session high, conditional Tail sits at 16-17 through the rest of today's cash session and eases to 16 at the 20:00 UTC close, where mechanical imbalance flow is scored into Stress at 56 rather than into Tail. The 21:00 UTC maintenance break is the structural low of the horizon at 9, and the estimate then holds a 10-11 overnight floor through the Asian hours in normal and mixed modes. From the 07:00 UTC European open the path drifts up through 12-13 as the keynote countdown compresses positioning, reaching 14 in the U.S. pre-market and 17 in the 13:00 UTC hour that carries the Friday cash open alongside Chicago PMI. The only two hours outside the low band are conditional Tail 22 at 14:00 UTC for Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote alongside the preliminary payroll benchmark revision and final Michigan sentiment, and 21 at 15:00 UTC for the structurally multi-stage second leg that follows. Event weight is carried mainly by Stress, which climbs from 50 to 72 across the horizon, rather than by an asserted price path: nothing about the keynote's content can be known at the assessment cutoff.

forecastDetail.comment: The 29,660 ceiling that rejected three times has broken and price is holding within five points of the new session high, which lifts Tail from 11 to 16. It stays in the low band because volatility is decaying into the break rather than expanding, and one clean retracement has already been supplied today.

Conditional Tail 17 for the retest hour. A pullback that holds 29,600 cash shifts the range up and leaves mean reversion intact; an advance that gives back nothing at all would be the session's first no-retracement signature, and that structure is not observed at the assessment cutoff.

Power hour carries conditional Tail 17 and Stress 55. Starting the hour at the session high is a different setup from starting it off a low, but late-session continuation remains an unobserved scenario at the cutoff rather than a structure that has formed.

The cash close maps Stress 56 against conditional Tail 16. Closing-auction flow is mechanical and usually resolves within the hour, so it is scored as a volatility and dispersion feature rather than as a mean-reversion failure mechanism.

The maintenance halt is the structural low of the horizon at Tail 9 and Stress 33. With the contract not trading for most of the hour there is no continuous path to fail; the low reading is mechanical and carries no directional content.

The reopen carries conditional Tail 11 on the assumption that the print re-establishes the settlement area. Immediate extension of the session high without a two-sided auction is the named invalidation, and it cannot be observed at the assessment cutoff.
